thread:
Maya (Docs): Heads-up: PR bump for examples. Found a confusing example that includes `project_id` in both the path and the request body. We should standardize on path params being authoritative and update snippets.
Liam (SDK): +1. SDKs should use path-only id. Show the body-only legacy case in a migration note only.
Rina (API): Current server behavior: path wins; body id is ignored (no 400). We need that spelled out in docs, or change runtime.
Maya (Docs): Let's document current behavior first (less risky). Add an explicit one-line callout: "Path parameters are authoritative; body ids are ignored if duplicated."
Sam (Platform): Also add a short migration checklist: what to change client-side, and note future enforcement might return 400. Keep it brief.
Alex (Eng): I'll add an infra ticket to lock regression tests so this behavior doesn't accidentally flip: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/issues/912
Liam (SDK): Suggested snippet change for clarity:
```
# confusing (do not use)
POST /v1/projects/abcd/items
{ "project_id": "abcd", "name": "widget" }

# recommended
POST /v1/projects/abcd/items
{ "name": "widget" }
```
And show Go example as: CreateItem(ctx, "abcd", CreateItemRequest{Name: "widget"})
Maya (Docs): I'll update the OpenAPI example file (examples/openapi/project-items.yaml) and the curl/py/go snippets in the ref page. DocCI flagged an E302 earlier.
DocCI Bot: docs/pr-4872: lint error E302 3 - example had duplicate path param in payload.
Maya (Docs): Fixed that example and added a short migration note. Pushed changes to PR #4872 and requested reviews from @Rina and @Liam.
Rina (API): Please also add a short description on the `project_id` path param: "Authoritative identifier for the request; if present in body it will be ignored." That helps generators and SDKs.
Liam (SDK): Small nit: in Go snippet prefer using a passed ctx variable over context.Background(). I'll note that in a review comment.
Sam (Platform): Once docs are merged, Alex can queue the infra test and we can later decide whether to change runtime to 400. For now doc-first approach agreed.
Maya (Docs): Thanks all; PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4872. I'll merge once approvals are in and DocCI is green.
DocCI Bot: docs/pr-4872: CI passed after example fix. :white_check_mark:
